dedupe_keys.name: global dataset of historical yields gdhy v1 2 and v1 3

description: The Global Dataset of Historical Yields (GDHY) gives annual gridded yields, in tonnes per hectare, of maize, rice, wheat and soybean worldwide, from 1981 to 2016 on a 0.5 degree grid. This aligned release combines version 1.2 (1981 to 2010) with version 1.3 (2011 to 2016), realigned so that the switch between satellite products does not break the series. It was produced by Toshichika Iizumi and published on the PANGAEA data repository on 26 November 2019 as a supplement to a 2020 data paper. The data come as a 15.2 MB ZIP archive, free under a CC BY 4.0 licence, citable through its DOI. Caveats: yields are estimated by combining national and subnational statistics with satellite vegetation indices, so grid values are modelled, not observed, the series ends in 2016 and only four crops are covered. For simulation it provides historical yield anomalies for testing crop models, estimating the agricultural losses caused by droughts, floods and heat waves, and calibrating climate adaptation and food-supply resilience studies. It is related to the AgERA5 record in this catalogue, which supplies the weather that explains many of these yield shocks.
